title: Axiomarium evidence record
description: The latest run of a check declared in axiomarium.yaml, kept as .axm/evidence/<check>.json: what ran, how it ended, and a hash of each file the check covered when it ended.

schemaVersion.description: The version of the record's shape, 1, which changes only through a decision in ROADMAP.md.

exit.description: Its exit code. Left out when a failure didn't say which.

folder.description: The folder it ran in, relative to the repo root with forward slashes, or . for the root. A run below the root may test only part of the repo.

tool.description: axm evidence record, which ran the command itself, or the hook, which saw an agent run it.

harness.description: The harness the agent ran in, for the hook.

session.description: The harness's session id, for the hook.

head.description: The commit HEAD named when the command ended, for the reader: freshness never uses it. Left out in a repo with no commit.

covers.description: The check's covers globs when it ran, empty for every file git sees. A check whose covers changed since is stale.

files.description: Each file the check covered when the command ended, with its SHA-256.

path.description: The file, relative to the repo root with forward slashes.

hash.description: sha256: and the SHA-256 of the file's bytes in lowercase hex.
